node.title: L1 maximal background-anchor injection and stratum ledger
node.statement: In one maximal sunflower chart, fix the exact defect d, exact background support of size r, exact touched petals, and exact nonempty petal supports with largest size a_*. The fixed listed-codeword layer injects both into a largest-petal cofactor space and into the exact background quotient space, so its size is at most q^max(0,d-max(r,a_*)+1). Summing support patterns gives the explicit (t,u,r,E) cap binom(b,r)binom(M,t)binom(t ell,u)(ell+E+1)q^gamma with gamma=min(E+floor(u/t)+1,max(0,E+ell-r+1)). This is a per-chart fixed-stratum payment, not an aggregate mixed-petal closure.
